title: Golden-vector manifest (ADR 0013 5.2 / 5.4)
description: Structurally compared golden vectors for the published field contract. MQTT (ADR 0013 5.2): payloads embedded as JSON objects because the contract is field-normative (names/presence/types/null-omission binding; member order and whitespace are not) — one manifest per authority ('field' = lifted from the Go producer paths, 'ems' = lifted from the C# MqttJson serializer), each side regenerates only its own file. Modbus (ADR 0013 5.4): register wire images (words per address/table) lifted through the C# codec (RegisterDecoder / the real ModbusCommandSink write path) — one manifest per shipped mapping profile, both authority 'ems' (the wire layout is fully determined by profile + schema semantics; bess-ems is the contract provider), both regenerated from C#.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Naming follows the replay-manifest.v1 precedent.

contract.description: Which field contract the vectors pin; selects the case shape (mqtt -> message cases, modbus -> register cases).

authority.description: Producer authority. MQTT per ADR 0013 3: 'field' covers telemetry/status/fault/command_ack (Go simulator is the de-facto producer), 'ems' covers command (C# EMS produces). Modbus: always 'ems' — the C# codec is the contract's reference implementation for both directions.

profile.description: Modbus only: file name of the mapping profile under config/examples/adapters/ these vectors are lifted from (e.g. modbus.simulator.json).

name.description: Unique case name within the manifest.

topic_name.description: Logical topic name as declared in the mqtt-mapping profile.

direction.description: Direction from the .NET-EMS adapter's perspective, same vocabulary as mqtt-mapping.json.

topic.description: Resolved broker topic with the fixed test asset id substituted (e.g. battery/asset-1/telemetry).

retained.description: Retained flag from the mqtt-mapping profile.

payload.description: The normative payload as a JSON object (field-normative; never a byte-encoded string).

suppressed.description: The producer emits NO message for this input (e.g. fault topic with fault_status ok/empty). Mutually exclusive with payload.

name.description: Unique case name within the manifest.

register.description: Register name exactly as declared in the mapping profile.

direction.description: read = the field serves this register (EMS FC03/FC04 read); write = the EMS writes it (FC06/FC16 holding write, lifted from the real ModbusCommandSink).

register_table.description: Resolved register table (loader default 'holding' applied when the profile omits it).

address.description: Start address from the mapping profile.

type.description: Register data type (mapping-schema vocabulary; 'string' registers carry no golden vectors).

word_order.description: Resolved 32-bit word order (loader default 'high_low' applied when the profile omits it; irrelevant for single-word types but pinned for completeness).

scale_factor.description: Scale factor from the profile: engineering value = raw wire value * scale_factor.

value.description: Engineering value. Chosen so raw = value / scale_factor is float32-exact (float32) or integral within type and range bounds (int types) — Decode(words) == value holds exactly, no tolerances in the contract.

words.description: The normative wire image: register words in transmission order starting at 'address'.
